verify.json has no round-trip spec. The only select the API echoes back is the language of an account user; a round-trip would create eight account users with the same e-mail address while deletes are asynchronous.
The Swagger file types the keypad code and the authorization type as integers, the guide's example sends strings. The connector sends integers.
